changeSet.author: sondos
changeSet.sql: CREATE OR REPLACE VIEW reports.vwservice AS SELECT s.id, s.name, s.abbreviation, s.code, s.category, s.price, s.currency, s.is_active, s.facility_id, s.appointable, s.parallel_capacity_value, s.default_duration_minutes, s.default_buffer_before_minutes, s.default_buffer_after_minutes, s.created_by, s.created_date, s.last_modified_by, s.last_modified_date, s.billing_rule_id FROM public.service s;

changeSet.author: sondos
changeSet.sql: GRANT USAGE ON SCHEMA reports TO report_user;
GRANT SELECT ON reports.vwservice TO report_user;

rollback.sql: REVOKE SELECT ON reports.vwservice FROM report_user;
